request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, gentle cello, light percussion, reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve names written in the scroll
Philip and Bartholomew
Matthew the tax collector
Thomas stands in the row

[Chorus]
James son of Alphaeus
Thaddaeus follows close
In the lists of the apostles
Their names are softly known

[Verse]
Upper room where they stayed
Peter and John are there
James and Andrew together
Philip and Thomas share

[Chorus]
James son of Alphaeus
Thaddaeus follows close
In the lists of the apostles
Their names are softly known

[Bridge]
Women watching from afar
Mary mother of James
Salome by her side
Waiting for the dawn

[Outro]
Spices bought to anoint
The Sabbath is over
James son of Alphaeus
In the story forever
